title: Unobstructed view of the satellite
body_md: An unobstructed view of the satellite must be ensured. Plastics, glass and wood are penetrated by the GPS signal and do not impair that view.
prev_context: Before this stands the requirement on the position in the vehicle.
next_context: The paragraph on the optional external GPS antenna follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 7: equivalent in substance. Both versions place the term in quotation marks and name only the permeable materials, never the shielding ones; the gap exists in both.
